entities.name: Battle of White Ridge
entities.description: Battle between wizards in White Ridge in 4073 AR that destroyed the village.

entities.name: White Ridge
entities.description: Village in the Whispering Woods destroyed in the battle.

entities.name: Dacian
entities.description: Wizard who fought Towser for a fallen object.

entities.name: Towser
entities.description: Wizard rival of Dacian who later took Gull into his service.

entities.name: Helki
entities.description: Centaur summoned by Dacian and controlled by mind magic.

entities.name: Gorman
entities.description: Towser's previous freight master who died in the battle.

events.summary: An object falls in the Whispering Woods and Dacian and Towser meet to contend for it.
events.quote: the wizards Dacian and Towser met outside White Ridge to contend for it

events.summary: Each wizard summons armies and creatures to fight.
events.quote: Dacian summoned a phalanx of soldiers in silver-scaled armor.

events.summary: The forces clash in the village, killing combatants and civilians, and an earthquake destroys nearly every cottage.
events.quote: Dacian summoned an earthquake that destroyed nearly every cottage in the village.

events.summary: Dacian drains survivors' life, Towser attacks with a stone rain, and survivors die of Black Plague.
events.quote: Dacian, flying above the scene, drained the life from the survivors

events.summary: Gull and Greensleeves refuse to leave; Sparrow Hawk has vanished.
events.quote: Their younger brother, Sparrow Hawk , had vanished in the destruction

events.summary: Gull finds Helki, Holleb and Liko, who reveal they were controlled by wizards.
events.quote: wizards controlled them with mind magic, forcing them into battle against their will

events.summary: Towser arrives, offers Gull service, and releases the centaurs and Liko.
events.quote: offered Gull a place in his service

relations.quote: the wizards Dacian and Towser met outside White Ridge to contend for it
They were joined by the centaurs Helki and Holleb , and the giant Liko .
